title: What information should be sent for a custom corrugated box quote? - MUGE PACKAGING SourceBridge
company: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
buyer_question: What information should be sent for a custom corrugated box quote?
buyer_context: DTC ecommerce shipments, retail replenishment, sample kits and product delivery packs
short_answer: A quote-ready brief should give the supplier enough context to review structure, material, print and packing direction before pricing. For corrugated mailer boxes, MUGE PACKAGING recommends sending packed product size, board and flute direction, delivery route, print coverage, fulfillment and unboxing need, plus artwork status and the target market.
